text:
marcus: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for the quickstart walkthrough. Replaced screenshots (mobile + desktop), added a JS streaming example, and removed the deprecated auth snippet. PTAL when you have a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842  Please check screenshots, alt text, and the example outputs. Hoping to merge today for a small docs push.

Talia: @marcus quick Q — the mobile screenshots look cropped on the preview. Can you reduce width and add alt text for a11y? Also can we add a one-line caption explaining token counts?

marcus: Yep — I pushed an update that reduces widths and adds alt text. Also added a short caption for token counts. Files touched: docs/quickstarts/js/README.md and docs/assets/qs-screens/*

elyse: Heads-up — your README change overlaps with my embeddings examples patch (PR #839). There's a small conflict on the example link. Can you rebase onto main or I can rebase after your merge.

samir: :eyes: I can review the code samples. Marcus — can you paste the snippet you added so I can grep locally?

marcus: Snippet I added: ```js
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'redwood/gpt-3.5', input: 'hello' });
console.log(res.output_text);
```
I also added a streaming variant below it.
\
deploy-bot: CI check: docs-lint — failed. Reason: screenshot filenames exceed 64 chars (docs/assets/qs-screens/very-long-filename-example-2026-01-15-desktop.png). Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/842

marcus: On it — renaming assets now (shorter names) and will push in ~5m.

Talia: :thumbsup: once CI is green can someone merge? We want this before the 18:00 docs release window.

elyse: If Marcus pushes the fix in the next 10m I can rebase and merge right after CI passes.

samir: I'll do a quick pass on the JS example in ~20m. Ping me @samir if it's still open.

marcus: Pushed asset rename + alt text + caption changes. Updated paths in README.

deploy-bot: CI check: docs-lint — passed. Preview build: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-842

Talia: :shipit: from docs/devex side — looks good.

elyse: Rebased and merged to main, cut docs release branch. Thanks everyone! :tada: 

samir: Quick look was fine, nice cleanup on the examples.
